_note: The wildflower bed at the foot of the front wall's left end. flower--1..3 are the always-present CSS blooms sown by hand on Day 17 (2026-05-25) and taught to breathe on Day 18; they are the bed's root and never turn, and two of them are the blooms the bee alights on. Everything below is garden.js's. Each entry here is one PLANT's wheel, not one slot's occupant (Day 115, 2026-08-31): sproutOffsetDays counts bloom-days after `planted` until it first comes up; then, within cycleDays, it is a green bud for youngWindowDays, an open rose for openWindowDays, a spent russet for spentWindowDays, and then it drops and its ground sits bare for the rest of the round. When it comes up again it comes up in the NEXT of its `seats` — a bed reseeds beside itself rather than refilling the same hole, which is the whole difference between ground and the pot by the door. cycleDays is per-plant on purpose: four plants in open ground do not agree on how long a life is, so they drift in and out of phase over years instead of marching in formation. The bed's floor is the three standing stems, not a spacing. Bloom-days, not days: one calendar day is worth 1 + 0.6 * yearSwing of them (bloom-clock.js), so the whole bed races in the warm and slows in the cold at exactly the pace the door pot does. To tend the bed — sow another plant, add a seat, change a life-length — edit this file; the home view reads it the next morning. A new seat number also needs a flower--N position block in scene.css, at BOTH the default and the max-width:599px layouts.
